# Bisect between good and bad

`customer_support.pb.root_cause_analysis.bisect_between_good_and_bad` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Bisect between the last known good and the first known bad along whichever axis is cheapest to halve — version, configuration, tenant, data set, time window.

Bisection converges without requiring a theory, and theories are what make investigations stall. It is the only technique on this list that works when nobody understands the subsystem.
